findings.evidence: `rg -n "disjSum_mem_join_iff" code/TauCeti` hits line 86 with no preceding `@[simp]`; Mathlib has simp lemmas for `toLeft_disjSum` and `toRight_disjSum`, but not for the full nonempty disjoint-sum membership condition.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to this theorem so `simp` reduces `s.disjSum t ∈ join K L` to the two component face conditions.
findings.issue: `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.disjSum_mem_join_iff` is the characteristic normal form for membership of constructed join faces, but it is not marked `@[simp]`.

findings.evidence: `rg -n "disjSum_mem_join_iff" code/TauCeti` hits line 162 with no preceding `@[simp]`, while the general `mem_join_iff` at line 153 is tagged.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to the abstract version as well.

summary: The join API exposes the needed core definitions and constructors, but its disjoint-union membership normal form is not registered for automation.
